posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
Important question! How do you all pronounce “X-TREME?”

I had been going up into high pitch on the “TREME” and drawing it out like it’s a hair metal guitar solo. But Christopher and Adam went down into a low monster truck register instead.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Trajector:

Important question! How do you all pronounce "X-TREME?"

I had been going up into high pitch on the "TREME" and drawing it out like it's a hair metal guitar solo. But Christopher and Adam went down into a low monster truck register instead.

I pronounce it the same way, mainly because I grew up in the same era C&A did, and whole thing with "X-TREME" as a term pretty much came out of "extreme" sports and the related sports announcing in the 90s, where the announcers would say that everything was "X-TREME!" in that exact monster truck sort of voice.

Like I find it notable that the XTRemiverse doesn't seem to actually really specifically parody the "Dark Age of Comics" gritty grimdark edgy stuff that much, it instead just parodies how everything had to be over the top and crazy and super-macho in the 90s which matches the extreme sports origin side of things more closely instead.

posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
Jeysie:

mainly because I grew up in the same era C&A did

Same here - born in '84. But somehow my brain went to high wailing guitar riffs before it went to extreme sports announcers!

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Admittedly part of it too is that I'm primarily a folk music and oldies and 80s pop aficionado; not genres where wailing guitars show up terribly often. (Wailing violins and fiddles maybe...)

I think XPW Argent would definitely say XTreme your way!
